title: Count Square Sum Triples
goal: Count ordered positive integer triples satisfying a squared plus b squared equals c squared.
strategy: Enumerate each unordered pair of distinct legs once. A perfect-square sum within the bound contributes both leg orders; equal positive legs cannot have an integer hypotenuse.
